name: quizzards
description: Live Quiz Scoreboard — a real-time, multi-team leaderboard for running quiz nights.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @quizzards/shared && npm run build --workspace @quizzards/client && npm run build --workspace @quizzards/server
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @quizzards/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
